q_001.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'

q_002.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_approved_amount FROM loan WHERE status = 'A'

q_003.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp WHERE type = 'OWNER'

q_004.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payments), 2) AS average_monthly_payment FROM loan

q_005.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND district.A11 > 10000

q_006.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS distinct_owner_clients FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND dist.A3 = 'Prague'

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM trans WHERE account_id = 1 AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'

q_008.sql: SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT di.client_id) AS owner_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id WHERE d.A3 = 'south Moravia' AND di.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2 ORDER BY owner_count DESC

q_009.sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 5

q_010.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE l.status = 'C' AND c.gender = 'M' AND dist.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
